_doc: PRE-REGISTRATION for the P18 connectome relabelling study of (H64, H42). Written and COMMITTED BEFORE the study was launched (queue item P11: a pre-registration whose precedence rests on an mtime is not a pre-registration). Nothing below was chosen after seeing a single relabelled run.
what_is_being_tested: autoresearch/audit.py --gate promotion FAILs exactly one check on connectome for H64: relabel.connectome, because no relabelling study is registered for the triple (H64, H42, connectome). Every other connectome check PASSES (effect_size +0.1041 vs +0.0120; protocol_ci CI_lo +0.0807; provenance; runtime 1185 s; runtime_guard 5/5 clean; compute equal at 20,000 grad steps). This study is the evidence that check demands.
out_path_note: --out is passed EXPLICITLY. The script's default output path for --dataset connectome is experiments/outputs/proto_P09_connectome.json, which is the REGISTERED H52|H42|connectome study. Running without --out would silently overwrite existing promotion evidence for a different pair.
R_justification: R = 4 non-identity relabellings (5 points including the identity). This is campaign.yaml promotion_gate.primary.degenerate_pool_rule.min_relabellings, i.e. a constant of the campaign, not a number chosen for this study; it is also the R the registered H52|H42|connectome study used. relabel_gate.py's own docstring requires R to be fixed in the pre-registration because the min-rule is stopping-rule sensitive.
stopping_rule: R is FIXED AT 4 AND WILL NOT BE EXTENDED. If the study fails at R = 4, that failure is the verdict for this cycle. Buying additional relabellings after seeing a failure is precisely the manipulation the min-rule's stopping-rule sensitivity permits, and this cycle forswears it in advance. If the study passes at R = 4, this cycle will likewise not add relabellings to strengthen it.
criterion: NOT chosen here. The verdict is computed by autoresearch/relabel_gate.py:evaluate(), which was written before the data it adjudicates and is invoked by audit.py. It is quoted below for the record only; if this text and the code ever disagree, THE CODE IS THE CRITERION.

criterion_as_coded.test_1_min_rule: delta_r > 0.012 pp for EVERY row r, including the identity.
criterion_as_coded.test_2_paired_lower_bound: mean(delta) - t_{0.95, n-1} * sd(delta)/sqrt(n) > 0.012 pp, with n = 5 points and t_{0.95,4} = 2.131847.
criterion_as_coded.test_3_identity_anchor: The r=0 row must reproduce the recorded confirm means to within 1e-9 pp: comparator H42 = 84.15409511053134, variant H64 = 84.25817950936937. By pre-registration (proto_P09_prereg.json) a failure here VOIDS the study rather than failing it - it would mean the script's harness bypass does not reproduce the harness, and no conclusion of any sign could be drawn.

prediction.reasoning: The delta under test is +0.104084 pp against a 0.012 pp bar - 8.67x the bar. The only measured paired-delta dispersion on this pipeline is 0.002011 pp (cycle 9, H52|H42, n=5), which would put the paired lower bound at roughly +0.1021 and would require a ~46 sigma excursion for any single relabelling to fall below the bar.
prediction.why_it_is_nevertheless_a_real_test: H64 is NOT nested in H42. H52 appended a monotone stage to H42's pipeline, so its delta_r >= 0 held with probability 1 and relabel_gate.py's D4 note warns that positivity was not evidence for that pair. H64 instead SWAPS the stage-2 surrogate (torch.sigmoid -> H38._asym_surrogate) inside the pipeline, so the two arms diverge from the first gradient step, the pairing is statistical rather than exact, and delta_r CAN come back negative. Meta-rule M10 sharpens this: the relabelling nuisance of this pipeline is created almost entirely in the SHARED PREFIX (greedy-FAS tie-breaks -> Rocket), whole-pipeline sigma 0.019124 pp versus tail-only 0.003731 pp - and stage 2 is IN that prefix. So H64's paired dispersion should be materially larger than H52's, plausibly up to sqrt(2)*0.019124 = 0.02704 pp if the two arms' prefix nuisance were uncorrelated. Even at that pessimistic value the paired lower bound is +0.0783 and the min-rule needs a 3.4 sigma excursion, so the prediction stands - but it is a prediction about a quantity this campaign has never measured for a non-nested pair, and the study is how it gets tested rather than assumed.
prediction.secondary_quantity_of_interest: sd(delta_r) itself. If it comes back near 0.002 pp the prefix nuisance is strongly common-mode and cancels even for a non-nested pair; if it comes back near 0.027 pp it does not. Either answer refines M10 and is worth recording whatever the verdict.

what_a_pass_does_and_does_not_authorise.does: Closes relabel.connectome, which is the ONLY FAIL audit.py --gate promotion reports on connectome for H64.
what_a_pass_does_and_does_not_authorise.does_not: Authorise a promotion by itself. H64's microns evidence is separately unusable: 3 of its 5 microns confirm runs were truncated by the wall-clock guard, and cycle 16 established ON THE UNMODIFIED CHAMPION (results/20260827T092101Z-H42-microns-s42-verify-f91b66.json, degraded at 3495.3 s) that this is the machine under sustained load and not the mechanism - queue item P19. Whether a connectome-only champion change is legitimate while the other primary is UNMEASURED is a separate decision, to be taken at this cycle's decide rung against CAMPAIGN.md's 'a gain that lives on one dataset' warning, and it is NOT pre-decided here in either direction.
what_a_pass_does_and_does_not_authorise.explicitly_not_claimed_in_advance: This pre-registration takes no position on whether H64 will be promoted. It fixes only how the relabelling evidence will be read.

voiding_conditions: The identity row fails to reproduce the two recorded confirm means to 1e-9 pp (test 3 above).
verify_frozen_manifest() fails at study start - the script checks this itself before anything runs.

Any run in the study is truncated by the runtime guard. The study calls runtime_guard.resolve('connectome', None), i.e. the same deadline production runs get. Connectome runs are ~1185 s against that deadline and the five connectome confirm runs of cycle 16 were flat within 3.0 s, so this is not expected - but the box has now been under load for 20h50m in the last 24 h (P19), so it is named here in advance rather than explained away afterwards.
runtime_expectation: ~3.3 h: 5 labellings x 2 arms x ~1185 s. Connectome only; microns is not needed and is not run.
